stem:
Qadir has two paper triangles of the same shape and size. One fits exactly over the other after he flips it.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: They are congruent only if he does not flip or rotate either triangle.
They are congruent: exact copies under superimposition, and flipping is allowed.
Same shape alone is enough for congruence even when the sizes differ.
Congruence here requires a right angle, hypotenuse, and one matching side before he can decide.

teacher.key_rationale: Congruent figures match in shape and size under exact superimposition; rotation or flipping is allowed. Banning flips reverses the allowed check; same shape without size substitutes a weaker label; requiring RHS conflates a right-triangle congruence test.
